full_judgment: 3. Defendant Nos. 1-5 contested the suit by filing written statement denying the material allegations stating, inter alia, that Afaz Mondal, Akbar Mondal, Khanaz Mondal and Chhanuddin Mondal predecessor-in-interest of the contesting defendants Nos. t to 5 purchased the suit land along with other lands by kabala dated 14.5.40 and also obtained settlement by patta dated 27.8.40 from the original owners and have been in possession of the suit land and their names were recorded correctly in the RS Khatian. Their further case is that Chhanuddin Mondal possessed 10 decimals of land of the suit plot and the plaintiff possessed 11 decimals of land of the suit plot. The suit plot being contiguous to the homestead of Chhanuddin Mondal and the said 11 decimals of land of the plaintiffs being required for the purpose of his pathway for ingress and egress to the main road from his house Chhanuddin Mondal got the said 11 decimals of land by way of exchange of his 10 decimals of land of plot No. 83 and since then the said Chhanuddin Mondal and after his death the defendants are in possession of the suit land by using part of the same as their pathway and the remaining part by cultivation and having also grown different kinds of trees by the side of the pathway; that the plaintiff having no title and possession in the suit land out of grudge to misappropriate the khayer trees, the plaintiff filed the suit; that the defendants were not aware of any compromise decree or ex parte decree in Title Suit No. 113 of 1950 and at that time defendant No. 1 was a minor and other defendants were female and, as such, decree is fraudulent and not binding upon the defendants.
